records.source: Did you watch the game last night?#$b#Or wait, do you even have a TV set...?
records.translation: Napanood mo ba ang laro kagabi?#$b#O teka, may telebisyon ka ba...?

records.source: Ugh, I stepped in something gross earlier... and I just bought these shoes.$s
records.translation: Ugh, may naapakan akong nakakadiri kanina... at kabibili ko lang ng sapatos na ito.$s

records.source: Hey, I'm Sam. Good to meet you.$h
records.translation: Hoy, ako si Sam. Ikinagagalak kitang makilala.$h

records.source: Aw yeah... Pizza time!$h
records.translation: Ayos... Oras na para sa pizza!$h

records.source: Hey, hey, hey! You remembered! Now that's what I'm talking about!$h
records.translation: Hoy, hoy, hoy! Naalala mo! Iyan ang gusto kong marinig!$h

records.source: Hey, hey, hey! You rememb--$h#$b#...*sniff*...*sniff*... what's that gnarly smell...?$8#$b#...Oh.$5
records.translation: Hoy, hoy, hoy! Naala--$h#$b#...*singhot*...*singhot*... ano ang matinding bahong iyon...?$8#$b#...Ah.$5

records.source: Oh... with me? Hehe... Yeah, sure. Sounds fun!$10
records.translation: Ah... kasama ako? Hehe... Oo, sige. Mukhang masaya!$10

records.source: Whaa! Is it acid? Will it burn through the roof and sizzle us alive?$8#$b#I gotta keep my little brother safe!$7
records.translation: Whaa! Asido ba iyan? Tutunawin ba nito ang bubong at pipirituhin tayong buhay?$8#$b#Kailangan kong panatilihing ligtas ang nakababatang kapatid ko!$7

records.source: Seems like there's no damage to anything... That was a strange one. How are you holding up?
records.translation: Mukhang walang nasira... Kakaiba iyon. Ayos ka lang ba?

records.source: You notice how warm this rain is? It feels alive...
records.translation: Napansin mo bang mainit ang ulang ito? Parang buhay...

records.source: Um... So, can I get a kiss now?$l
records.translation: Um... Kung gayon, maaari ba kitang halikan ngayon?$l

records.source: I couldn't sleep last night. I was imagining all the things we're gonna do together.$10
records.translation: Hindi ako nakatulog kagabi. Iniisip ko ang lahat ng gagawin natin nang magkasama.$10

records.source: Whoaa... Hold on... this is for me? I never expected this! Thank you!
records.translation: Whoaa... Sandali... para sa akin ba ito? Hindi ko ito inaasahan! Salamat!

records.source: I heard you and Sebastian are going out... he better still be coming to band practice every week!
records.translation: Narinig kong magkasintahan na kayo ni Sebastian... dapat ay pumupunta pa rin siya sa ensayo ng banda bawat linggo!

records.source: Wow, I can't believe you and Sebastian got hitched. Times really are changing...$u#$e#Eh, it's alright, I'm sure he'll still have time to hang out.
records.translation: Wow, hindi ako makapaniwalang nagpakasal kayo ni Sebastian. Talagang nagbabago na ang panahon...$u#$e#Eh, ayos lang, sigurado akong may oras pa rin siyang makipagkita.

records.source: Hey, what's the big idea? You took my drummer!$8#$b#Haha, just kidding... Congrats!$h
records.translation: Hoy, ano ba? Kinuha mo ang drummer ko!$8#$b#Haha, nagbibiro lang... Binabati kita!$h

records.source: I better lay low for a while. I wouldn't want to get on Mayor Lewis' bad side!
records.translation: Dapat muna akong umiwas nang ilang panahon. Ayaw kong mapasama ang loob sa akin ni Alkalde Lewis!

records.source: Heheh... So you've been to the sewer, huh? I've snuck down there a few times myself. It's pretty creepy.#$e#How could I tell? Hmm... let's just say... 'the nose knows'.$h
records.translation: Heheh... Kaya nakapunta ka na sa mga Imburnal, ha? Palihim na rin akong bumaba roon nang ilang beses. Medyo nakatatakot iyon.#$e#Paano ko nalaman? Hmm... sabihin na lang nating... “alam ng ilong”.$h

records.source: Wouldn't it be cool if the town had a skate park, though?#$b#Now, how to convince Mayor Lewis...$s
records.translation: Pero hindi ba astig kung may skate park ang bayan?#$b#Ngayon, paano kaya makukumbinsi si Alkalde Lewis...$s

records.source: Even with all the practice we did, I made a bunch of mistakes on stage... I hope no one noticed.$s#$e#It's kind of nerve-wracking to be in front of everyone!$h
records.translation: Kahit sa dami ng ensayo natin, marami akong naging pagkakamali sa entablado... Sana ay walang nakapansin.$s#$e#Nakakakaba palang humarap sa lahat!$h

records.source: If... I mean when... my Dad gets back, I wonder if he'll be the same as I remember him?$s
records.translation: Kung... ibig kong sabihin, kapag... bumalik si Tatay, magiging katulad pa rin kaya siya ng naaalala ko?$s

records.source: Wow, what a spot!
records.translation: Wow, napakagandang lugar!

records.source: I bet there's some cool stuff deeper on the island.#$e#Willy said we have to stay here, though... some kind of liability issues or something.$s
records.translation: Siguradong may mga astig na bagay sa mas malalim na bahagi ng isla.#$e#Pero sinabi ni Willy na kailangan nating manatili rito... may problema raw sa pananagutang legal o kung ano.$s

records.source: I'm feeling pretty good from all the sunlight.$h
records.translation: Ang sarap ng pakiramdam ko dahil sa lahat ng sikat ng araw.$h

records.source: Check out these gnarly waves... Guess what? I'm gonna save up for a surfboard.
records.translation: Tingnan mo ang matitinding alon na ito... Hulaan mo? Mag-iipon ako para sa isang surfboard.

records.source: %Sam is playing a jazzy tune on his guitar.
records.translation: %Tumutugtog si Sam ng himig-jazz sa gitara niya.

records.source: Maybe I should learn to play the ukulele.#$e#Abby on the congas and Sebastian on the steel drums... 'The Pelicans of Paradise'...$s#$e#What's the matter, you look worried.$h
records.translation: Baka dapat akong matutong tumugtog ng ukulele.#$e#Si Abby sa mga conga at si Sebastian sa mga steel drum... “Ang mga Pelican ng Paraiso”...$s#$e#Ano'ng problema, mukha kang nag-aalala.$h

records.source: I'm just getting juiced up, then it's back to the beach.
records.translation: Iinom lang ako nang kaunti, pagkatapos ay balik na sa dalampasigan.

records.source: Aw, I gotta put on that dorky suit again? I thought now that we're married... Well, alright.$s
records.translation: Aw, kailangan ko na namang isuot ang baduy na terno? Akala ko ngayong kasal na tayo... Aba, sige.$s

records.source: Hmm... I dunno. Maybe next year.$s
records.translation: Hmm... Ewan ko. Baka sa susunod na taon.$s

records.preserveReason: The value contains only an ellipsis and an emotion control token, with no translatable wording.

records.source: Alright, I'm done with the cold shoulder act. Let's just forget about what happened.$7
records.translation: Sige, tapos na ako sa pag-iwas sa iyo. Kalimutan na lang natin ang nangyari.$7

records.source: Wait... what?!$8#$b#I thought we were doing okay... I guess I was way off... alright, then.$9#$b#Yeah, sure... we can still be friends.$9
records.translation: Teka... ano?!$8#$b#Akala ko ay maayos tayo... Mukhang maling-mali ako... sige kung gayon.$9#$b#Oo, sige... maaari pa rin tayong maging magkaibigan.$9

records.source: I'm sorry, @. I don't think I can still be your friend.$s
records.translation: Paumanhin, @. Sa tingin ko'y hindi ko na kayang maging kaibigan mo.$s

records.source: Hey, how's it going?#$e#Last night I practiced guitar for 4 hours straight. My fingers hurt like crazy.$s#$e#Bye, I've got something to do...
records.translation: Hoy, kumusta?#$e#Nagsanay ako sa gitara nang apat na oras nang tuloy-tuloy kagabi. Napakasakit ng mga daliri ko.$s#$e#Paalam, may kailangan akong gawin...

records.source: Hey, farmer.
records.translation: Hoy, magsasaka.

records.source: I'll tell you a secret... my name 'Sam' is short for 'Samson'.$10#$e#Most people don't know that so keep it on mute.
records.translation: May sasabihin akong lihim... ang pangalang “Sam” ay pinaikling “Samson”.$10#$e#Hindi iyon alam ng karamihan kaya huwag mo itong ipagsabi.

records.source: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Take it easy.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta! Ikinagagalak kitang makitang muli.#$e#Dahan-dahan lang.

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Sleeping feels nice but sometimes I wish I could skip it... it's just such a time-waster.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Gusto mo bang tumambay o ano?#$e#Masarap matulog pero minsan ay sana malaktawan ko iyon... napakalaking aksaya lang kasi ng oras.

records.source: I'm trying to come up with a new song for my band, but I'm blanking...#$q 19/20 Wed_old#Hey.. What do you think my new song should be about?#$r 20 30 Wed_20#Farming, mining, and chopping wood.#$r 8820 30 Wed_20#A city in the sea.#$r 8821 30 Wed_20#Trains.#$r 19 -50 Wed_19#Choose anything. It'll still be a horrible song.
records.translation: Sinisikap kong makaisip ng bagong awitin para sa banda ko, pero wala akong maisip...#$q 19/20 Wed_old#Hoy.. Sa tingin mo, tungkol saan dapat ang bago kong awitin?#$r 20 30 Wed_20#Pagsasaka, pagmimina, at pagputol ng kahoy.#$r 8820 30 Wed_20#Isang lungsod sa dagat.#$r 8821 30 Wed_20#Mga tren.#$r 19 -50 Wed_19#Pumili ka ng kahit ano. Pangit pa rin ang awitin.

records.source: $p 19#But I already know what you think about it.$a|Thanks to your help I'm already done with the lyrics!$h
records.translation: $p 19#Pero alam ko na ang palagay mo tungkol doon.$a|Dahil sa tulong mo, tapos na ang liriko!$h

records.source: Hey, man... what the heck is your problem? Sorry I asked.$a
records.translation: Hoy, pare... ano ba ang problema mo? Paumanhin at nagtanong pa ako.$a

records.source: Hey, you know what? That sounds perfect. Thanks!$h
records.translation: Hoy, alam mo? Mukhang perpekto iyan. Salamat!$h

records.source: I've been friends with Sebastian for a while. He's a pretty cool guy.#$e#If you two weren't around I wouldn't really have any friends in town.
records.translation: Matagal na kaming magkaibigan ni Sebastian. Astig siyang lalaki.#$e#Kung wala kayong dalawa, wala talaga akong magiging kaibigan sa bayan.

records.source: Hey buddy. You look like you're full of energy today!^@. Um... I just wanted to say... You look nice today.$10
records.translation: Hoy, kaibigan. Mukhang punô ka ng lakas ngayon!^@. Um... Gusto ko lang sabihin... Maganda ang hitsura mo ngayon.$10

records.source: I think my Dad might be coming back in a year or so.#$e#I guess you might be able to meet him, then. If you're still living here.#$e#You wouldn't abandon the farm after putting so much effort into it!
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y baka bumalik si Tatay pagkalipas ng mga isang taon.#$e#Siguro ay makikilala mo siya kung gayon. Kung nakatira ka pa rin dito.#$e#Hindi mo pababayaan ang bukid matapos mong paglaanan iyon ng napakaraming pagsisikap!

records.source: ...I have mixed feelings about my father being back. He seems strange.$s#$b#But I guess I haven't seen him in 3 years... so that could explain it.
records.translation: ...Magkahalo ang damdamin ko sa pagbabalik ni Tatay. Parang kakaiba siya.$s#$b#Pero tatlong taon ko rin siyang hindi nakita... kaya baka iyon ang paliwanag.

records.source: *sigh*... what am I still doing here?
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... ano pa ba ang ginagawa ko rito?

records.source: The clouds look great this time of year, don't they?#$e#Like scoops of vanilla ice cream floating on blue raspberry sauce... Or maybe I'm just hungry.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng mga ulap sa ganitong panahon ng taon, hindi ba?#$e#Parang mga scoop ng sorbetes na vanilla na lumulutang sa asul na sawsawang raspberry... O baka gutom lang ako.

records.source: My Dad is a soldier, fighting against the Gotoro Empire. That's why he's not here...#$e#He'll come back someday.#$e#...I've heard some terrible things about the Gotoro Empire...$s
records.translation: Sundalo si Tatay na nakikipaglaban sa Imperyo ng Gotoro. Kaya wala siya rito...#$e#Babalik siya balang araw.#$e#...May narinig akong ilang kakila-kilabot na bagay tungkol sa Imperyo ng Gotoro...$s

records.source: Well, my Dad is back. Have you met him?#$b#I'm just glad he's okay.
records.translation: Aba, nakabalik na si Tatay. Nakilala mo na ba siya?#$b#Natutuwa lang akong ligtas siya.

records.source: Well, my Dad is back. Have you met him?#$b#I'm just glad he's okay.
records.translation: Aba, nakabalik na si Tatay. Nakilala mo na ba siya?#$b#Natutuwa lang akong ligtas siya.

records.source: Did I ever tell you we used to live in the city?#$e#There's a lot more stuff going on, but it's also kinda noisy and hectic... It's hard to say which is better.
records.translation: Nasabi ko na ba sa iyong dati kaming nakatira sa lungsod?#$e#Mas marami roong nangyayari, pero medyo maingay at magulo rin... Mahirap sabihing alin ang mas mabuti.

records.source: Dad used to work as a garbage man in the city.#$e#You don't even want to know some of the things he found in people's trash.
records.translation: Dati ay basurero si Tatay sa lungsod.#$e#Hindi mo gugustuhing malaman ang ilan sa mga bagay na nakita niya sa basura ng mga tao.

records.source: The older I get the more attached I feel to the valley.#$b#Although I could be biased... for a certain reason.$10#$e#So, how are you doing today?$h
records.translation: Habang tumatanda ako, lalo akong napapalapit sa lambak.#$b#Pero maaaring may dahilan akong kumiling dito...$10#$e#Kaya, kumusta ka ngayon?$h

records.source: Oh! I just remembered I'm supposed to call my Grandma. Okay, I'm going to put this rubber band on my wrist so I don't forget.#$e#I have to make little reminders for myself or else I'll totally forget to do things.$h
records.translation: Ah! Naalala ko lang na kailangan kong tawagan si Lola. Sige, ilalagay ko ang lastikong ito sa pulsuhan ko para hindi ko malimutan.#$e#Kailangan kong gumawa ng maliliit na paalala para sa sarili ko, kung hindi ay lubos kong nalilimutang gawin ang mga bagay.$h

records.source: Hmm. I just remembered that I was meaning to do something... But I forgot.#$e#This happens to me all the time.
records.translation: Hmm. Naalala ko lang na may balak akong gawin... Pero nalimutan ko.#$e#Palagi itong nangyayari sa akin.

records.source: Sometimes I wonder if my mother is actually happy with her life...$s#$e#I asked her once and got the feeling she was hiding some inner pain.
records.translation: Minsan ay iniisip ko kung tunay bang masaya si Nanay sa buhay niya...$s#$e#Minsan ko siyang tinanong at pakiramdam ko'y may itinatago siyang kirot sa kalooban.

records.source: Oh, it's a nice day... isn't it?
records.translation: Ah, maganda ang araw... hindi ba?
